verdict.rationale: Lever's Automation Hub lets users define rules that trigger actions (archiving, tagging, emailing, advancing candidates) automatically on events like stage changes, and webhooks/event payloads allow custom event-driven automation via the API. missing for 10: no evidence of a rules-builder UI with conditional logic detail, no independent/hands-on verification of automation reliability, and no documentation of the range of triggerable events beyond high-volume hiring examples.
